## Chapter 1 — The Universal Machine

- Stores and transforms information using simple, universal rules
- Programmable: behavior changes with instructions

## Chapter 1 — Program Power

- Programs are **recipes** for the computer
- Automate repetitive tasks
- Scale ideas from one to millions of users
- Turn data into insight (and action)

## Chapter 1 — Programming Languages

- Human-readable instructions → machine actions
- Syntax + semantics define valid programs and meaning
- High-level (Python) vs. low-level (C/assembly)
- Machine code -- what the computer actually uses.

::: {.notes}

Elaborate on each of these.

:::

## Chapter 1 — Python

- Widely used for education, data, web, automation, AI
- Emphasizes readability and succinct code
- Large ecosystem of libraries and tools
